headline: PPL Corp. Reports Q3 EPS of $0.54 and Raises Long-Term EPS Growth Outlook
summary: PPL Corporation reported third-quarter 2026 GAAP earnings of $0.49 per share and ongoing earnings of $0.54 per share, compared to $0.48 in 2025. The company narrowed its 2026 ongoing earnings forecast range and raised its long-term EPS growth outlook.
why: PPL Corporation is a major U.S. utility holding company delivering electricity and natural gas to customers, making its earnings and growth forecasts key indicators for the regulated utility sector.

impacts.name: PPL Corporation
impacts.why: PPL Corporation reported its own third-quarter earnings and updated its earnings guidance.
